build.buildCommand: npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: (i=1; until npx prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -gt 10 ]; then echo 'prisma migrate deploy failed after retries - aborting start'; exit 1; fi; echo "Database not ready, retrying prisma migrate deploy ($i/10)"; sleep 5; done) && node dist/index.js
